description: This file contains a shell script that tests the behavior of 'git checkout-index' with conflicting filesystem states, including files, directories, and symlinks. It sets up test scenarios for conflict resolution when checking out files from git into different work tree states and verifies the expected outcomes.

methods.name: show_files
methods.description: Displays the filesystem and cache status for files and directories involved in the test, using 'find', 'sed', and 'git ls-files/ls-tree'.
